newsitem.title: INDIA: India Bajaj recommends 1:2 bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: India Bajaj recommends 1:2 bonus issue.

text.p: India's leading two-wheeler maker Bajaj Auto Ltd on Monday said it set a bonus share issue in the ratio of one share for every two shares held.
"The company has recommended a capitalisation of its free reserves equivalent to an amount of 398.0 million rupees," Bajaj Auto said in a notice to the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE).
Bajaj Auto shares ended Monday at 867.0 rupees, down 3.75 from the prevous close, and off the say's high at 919.0.
Over 170,600 shares were traded at the BSE by the close of trading.
The ratio of the bonus issue was mostly in line with market expectations.
The company last week announced a five percent rise in 1996/97 (April-March) net profit to 4.40 billion rupees against 4.18 billion in the year-ago period.
Rahul Bajaj, chairman of Bajaj Auto last week said he was not in favour of the firm making a one-for-one bonus share issue.
